Scenic mountain reservoir surrounded by spice hills and seasonal cascades

name: Tenkasi Kasi Viswanathar & Old Courtallam
description: 15th-century Pandya royal temple crowned by a 180-foot Rajagopuram with life-size sculpted stone pillars, right beside Old Courtallam waterfalls.

spots.spotName: Tenkasi Kasi Viswanathar Temple & Sculpted Mandapam
spots.activity: Admire the wind-channeling entrance gopuram and exquisite Nayak-Pandya monolithic statues
200-foot stepped rock waterfall fed by the Chittar River with safe bathing pools

spots.spotName: Thirumalapuram Rock-Cut Cave Temple & Eco Park
spots.activity: Early Pandya rock-cut cave temple with ancient frescoes and landscaped Courtallam Eco Park

name: Thirumayam Fort & Avudaiyarkoil
description: 40-acre 17th-century ring fortress built by Sethupathi Raja over 8th-century rock-cut Shiva and Vishnu cave temples, paired with Avudaiyarkoil.

spots.activity: Climb to the concentric granite fort bastions, rock moat, and British-era cannon emplacements
Twin 8th-century Pallava-Pandya cave shrines carved into the base of Thirumayam Fort rock
Masterpiece of Tamil stone architecture where Saint Manickavasagar built the paper-thin granite roof eaves

name: Viralimalai Peacock Sanctuary & Kodumbalur
description: Rocky hillock shrine of Lord Shanmuganathar surrounded by hundreds of wild peacocks, near the 9th-century early Chola temples of Kodumbalur.

spots.spotName: Viralimalai Shanmuganathar Hill Temple & Peacock Sanctuary
spots.activity: Climb 207 stone steps shaded by floral trees as wild peacocks dance around the hillock

spots.spotName: Kodumbalur Moovar Koil (Early Chola Stone Temples)
spots.activity: Explore the 9th-century Irukkuvel-Chola structural stone temples and Muchukundeswarar shrine
Ancient Mutharaiyar-Pallava rock-cut Shiva and Ranganatha cave temples with painted reliefs

name: Bhavanisagar Dam & Kodiveri Falls
description: One of the world's largest earthen dams built across the Bhavani River paired with the curtain-like Kodiveri Weir waterfalls and coracle rides.

spots.spotName: Kodiveri Dam Waterfalls & Bhavani River Coracle Ride
spots.activity: Safe family bathing under the wide stone-check-dam waterfall and traditional round parisal boat ride
Walk through the 8-km earthen dam gardens at the confluence of Bhavani and Moyar rivers
Revered forest-edge Amman temple at the base of the Sathyamangalam ghats

name: Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve & Dhimbam
description: Critical wildlife corridor linking the Western and Eastern Ghats, famous for the thrilling 27-hairpin Dhimbam ghat drive, elephants, and Hasanur forests.

spots.activity: Scenic mountain ghat drive with sweeping views of Bhavanisagar reservoir and Moyar valley
Forest department safari spotting elephants, gaur, sambar deer & Nilgiri birds
Cool high-altitude forest plateau drive and ancient Thalamalai Perumal temple

name: Chennimalai & Vellode Bird Sanctuary
description: Kongu Nadu heritage route combining the hilltop Chennimalai Murugan Temple, handloom weaving center, and the Ramsar-listed Vellode Bird Sanctuary.

spots.spotName: Chennimalai Subramanya Swamy Hill Temple (1,320 Steps)
spots.activity: Ascend by ghat road or steps to the historic hill temple where Kanda Sashti Kavacham was first sung
Ramsar wetland sanctuary hosting painted storks, pelicans, teal & darter birds
Rare Trimurti temple enshrining Shiva, Vishnu (Veeranarayana Perumal) & Brahma on the Cauvery bank

name: Mettur Dam & Taramangalam (Salem)
description: One of India's largest and oldest stone masonry dams across the Cauvery River (Stanley Reservoir), paired with Taramangalam's intricate stone sculptures.

spots.activity: View the 1,700-meter-long dam across the Cauvery gorge, Muniappan statue & landscaped Ellis Park

spots.spotName: Taramangalam Kailasanathar Temple (Stone Chain & Yali Marvel)
spots.activity: Marvel at rotating stone lotus rings, stone chains & Rati-Manmatha sculptures
Shaded foothills nature park at the base of Yercaud hills with deer, peacocks & bamboo trails

name: Tiruchengode Ardhanareeswarar Hill
description: Ancient red-rock hill shrine (Nagagiri) with 1,200 carved steps and a 60-foot stone serpent, enshrining the half-male, half-female Ardhanareeswarar form of Shiva.

spots.activity: Drive or climb the 650-foot red hill past the giant 60-ft carved five-headed Naga sculpture
Historic Chola-Nayak temple in the heart of Tiruchengode with sculpted mandapams
Peaceful barrage across the Cauvery River with children's park and coracle boating

name: Bhavani Kooduthurai & Uratchikottai
description: Known as the 'Triveni Sangam of the South' where the Cauvery, Bhavani, and mystic Amudha rivers unite around the island shrine of Sangameswarar.

spots.spotName: Bhavani Sangameswarar Temple & Kooduthurai River Confluence
spots.activity: Sacred bath and darshan at the confluence of Cauvery and Bhavani rivers

spots.spotName: Uratchikottai Vedagiri Hill Bala Dhandayuthapani Temple
spots.activity: Hilltop Murugan shrine offering 360-degree views of both the Cauvery and Bhavani river valleys
Explore GI-tagged colorful Bhavani Jamakkalam carpet weaving workshops

name: Sathanur Dam & Tirukoilur
description: Major dam across the Thenpennai River nestled in the Chennakesava Hills, famous for its terraced cinema gardens, crocodile farm, and nearby Tirukoilur.

spots.spotName: Sathanur Dam Ornamental Gardens & Crocodile Park
spots.activity: Stroll through manicured gardens, statues, swimming pool park & mugger crocodile enclosure
Ancient Divya Desam where the First Three Alwars met and composed the earliest Prabandham hymns
Historic Sangam-era rock monument in the middle of the Ponnaiyar River honoring poet Kabilar

name: Amirthi Zoo & Jalagamparai Falls
description: Lush Javadi Hills foothills nature circuit featuring the Amirthi River waterfall and mini zoo alongside the scenic Jalagamparai Waterfalls near Tirupattur.

spots.activity: Trek 1 km along the forest stream to the seasonal waterfall and visit spotted deer & bird enclosures
Chola-Vijayanagara architectural gem famous for its Time-Indicating Stone Sundial and Nandi
Attaru River cascading down the outer slopes of Yelagiri Hills with a Lingam-shaped temple

name: Krishnagiri Dam & Rayakottai Fort
description: Land of monolithic hill forts (Baramahal) featuring the scenic KRP Dam gardens across the Thenpennai River, Krishnagiri Fort, and Rayakottai Fort.

spots.spotName: Krishnagiri Reservoir Project (KRP Dam) & Rose Park
spots.activity: Relax in the illuminated fountains, deer park, and lakeside gardens below the granite hills

spots.spotName: Krishnagiri Hill Fort & Syed Basha Mountains
spots.activity: Explore the historic Baramahal fortress built by Vijayanagara rulers and Tipu Sultan
Scenic evening hike up the granite steps of Rayakottai Fort for sunset views across the plateau

name: Keeladi Heritage Museum & Thirupuvanam
description: World-renowned Vaigai River civilization site showcasing 2,600-year-old Sangam-era urban artifacts in the Chettinad-style Keeladi Museum.

spots.spotName: Keeladi Heritage Museum (Sangam Era Archaeological Gallery)
spots.activity: Explore 6th-century BCE Tamil-Brahmi pottery, carnelian beads, ring wells, dice & weaving spindles

spots.spotName: Keeladi Open-Air Excavation Trench & Konthagai Site
spots.activity: View the actual brick structures and terracotta water pipelines unearthed along the Vaigai valley
Ancient Paadal Petra Sthalam on the Vaigai bank and famous Thirupuvanam pure silk saree weavers

name: Sikkal, Nagore & Ettukudi
description: Harmonious coastal pilgrimage circuit featuring Sikkal Singaravelavar Temple, the 500-year-old Nagore Dargah with five minarets, and Ettukudi Murugan.

spots.activity: Sacred Kanda Sashti shrine where Lord Murugan received the Vel spear from Goddess Parvati
Visit the 16th-century shrine of Shahul Hamid revered by people of all faiths and its silver doors
Admire the masterpiece monolithic stone peacock where the entire statue rests solely on the bird's legs

name: Mannargudi, Tiruvarur & Vaduvur
description: Heart of the Chola delta featuring Mannargudi Rajagopalaswamy Temple (Dakshina Dwarka with its 23-acre tank), Tiruvarur Thyagaraja Temple, and Vaduvur Sanctuary.

spots.spotName: Mannargudi Rajagopalaswamy Temple & Haridra Nadhi Tank
spots.activity: Explore 'Dakshina Dwarka' and India's largest 23-acre temple tank (1,158 ft × 837 ft)
Spot migratory waterbirds around the lush Vaduvur tank and visit the famous Rama shrine

spots.spotName: Tiruvarur Thyagaraja Swamy Temple, Kamalalayam & Aziya Ther
spots.activity: Birthplace of the Carnatic Music Trinity, 30-acre Kamalalayam tank & Asia's largest temple chariot

name: Thirunageswaram, Uppiliappan & Alangudi
description: Revered Navagraha and Divya Desam temple circuit near Kumbakonam-Tiruvarur featuring Thirunageswaram (Rahu), Uppiliappan Koil, and Alangudi (Guru).

spots.activity: Famous Rahu Sthalam known for the miracle of milk turning blue during Paal Abhishekam
Ancient Divya Desam known as South Tirupati where all temple prasadam is cooked completely without salt
Sacred Dakshinamurthy (Guru Bhagavan) shrine surrounded by three rivers in Tiruvarur district

name: Amaravathi Dam & Thirumoorthy Hills
description: Scenic Anamalai foothills getaway near Udumalpet combining the steep-stepped Amaravathi Dam viewpoint, crocodile park, and Panchalinga Falls at Thirumoorthy Hills.

spots.spotName: Amaravathi Dam Viewpoint & Mugger Crocodile Park
spots.activity: Climb the dam steps for sweeping views of the Anamalai & Palani hills and visit South India's largest crocodile park

spots.spotName: Thirumoorthy Hills Amanalingeswarar Temple & Dam Boating
spots.activity: Visit the boulder shrine of Brahma-Vishnu-Shiva and enjoy pedal boating on Thirumoorthy Reservoir
Scenic 3-km forest trail to the refreshing mountain waterfall cascading over Western Ghats rocks
